parsed.rationale: The second participating record (`Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, package `Wallpaper`) carries `is_sample_app: true`, indicating it is a standalone sample-app copy of `DebugMetricsProvider` that was intentionally duplicated for the WallpaperSampleApp example target rather than taking a dependency on the `DebugPanel` package. The sole structural difference — `metalDevice:MTLDevice?` vs `metalDevice:(any MTLDevice)?` — is a minor existential-syntax variant consistent with a hand-copied, independently maintained file rather than a refactor target. Consolidating the sample-app copy into the `DebugPanel` package would introduce an undesirable cross-package dependency from an example/demo target into a shared framework. The duplication is therefore intentional and falls squarely under the sample-app-mirror rule.
